# BusFlow

> BusFlow is sales, booking and invoicing software for coach operators, made by FlowSolutions d.o.o. (Croatia). A customer enters departure, destination and number of passengers; BusFlow calculates the route across Europe, the crew under EU driving-time rules, VAT by country and a binding price in seconds, takes the payment online and sends the invoice.

Each coach operator gets its own instance with its own brand, price list and fleet, with data in the EU. Onboarding takes 8–10 weeks. BusFlow has been running every day at the coach operator Omnibus Mikanović (Offenbach am Main) since August 2026.

## Language versions
